Text: We seek You, Lord, with humbled voices in the quiet of today's end. [t] We have encountered You as we celebrated the mystery of Your resurrection this day. [*] Let us now rest. Give us Your peace and protect us from all evils. Help us to awaken tomorrow praising You with joyful spirits
